text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... ...! Ah... hello, Trainer. My 
apologies for letting you see such a 
sloppy expression on my face.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"You've inherited your mother's 
late-stretch kick," a fan from her racing 
days told me... I couldn't help but let my 
joy slip out.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
In the final stretch, the roaring cheers 
seem to plead, 'This time for sure.' As if 
answering the call, her stride 
accelerates—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
My mother in the old footage I saw was 
truly, truly strong and beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
You saw their resemblance in me. Nothing 
could bring me greater joy... Fufu.
